objects.name: pkg_customer
conversion_notes: Oracle PACKAGE decomposed into multiple PostgreSQL functions within the same chunk object for JSON slot compatibility
Oracle DBMS_CRYPTO.HASH + UTL_I18N.STRING_TO_RAW replaced with pgcrypto digest(convert_to(text,'UTF8'),'sha256') (requires extension pgcrypto)
Oracle SYS_REFCURSOR OUT parameters converted to set-returning functions (RETURNS TABLE)
Oracle COMMIT/ROLLBACK removed (PostgreSQL functions cannot transaction-control); rely on caller transaction semantics
